Pin 6 SCL/SYNC is listed as "Output" in the pin table; it is the I2C clock / SPI chip-select input. Register addresses per Table 7-21: channel 0 at 13h-18h and 1Ch, channel 1 at 01h-06h and 19h.

registers.name: DAC_0_DATA
registers.note: input (buffer) register of channel 0: 12-bit code MSB left-aligned in bits 15-4

registers.name: COMMON_TRIGGER
registers.note: RESET (write-only) and the trigger bits self-reset, so they read 0 (modeled as readOnly); DEV-UNLOCK is stored

registers.name: COMMON_DAC_TRIG

registers.note: internal DAC (active) register of channel 0, same left-aligned layout as DAC-0-DATA

commands.name: SW_RESET
commands.note: COMMON-TRIGGER RESET = 1010: POR reset (External Reset); not blocked by DEV-LOCK

commands.name: LDAC_TRIGGER
commands.note: COMMON-TRIGGER LDAC = 1: channels with SYNC-CONFIG-X = 1 copy DAC-X-DATA to the output (the others already match)

commands.name: CLR_TRIGGER
commands.note: COMMON-TRIGGER CLR = 1: DAC registers and outputs to zero code (CLR-SEL-X = 0)

commands.name: WRITE_COMMON_TRIGGER
commands.note: COMMON-TRIGGER stays writable while DEV-LOCK = 1 (unlock code path)

commands.note: broadcast: channels with BRD-CONFIG-X = 1 ([0]) take the code (unlocked)

commands.name: WRITE

devices.description: Quad 16-bit voltage-output DAC (external VREFH/VREFL reference) with I2C interface (standard/fast/high-speed), extended address pins A3/A2, LDAC, read-back and per-channel power-down

devices.description: dual 12-bit temperature-compensated DAC (PA bias controller) with temperature sensor, EEPROM look-up table, I2C interface and FET drive outputs
devices.note: lmp92066.pdf (SNAS634B) p.3-4 (pin functions), p.5 (recommended operating conditions: VIO 1.65-3.3 V, VDD 4.75-5.25 V), p.7 (digital input characteristics), p.8 (I2C timing), p.20 (DAC: offset binary 12-bit input), p.22-24 (memory, block writing, access control Tables 4-5, EEPROM Tables 6-7), p.25-28 (I2C protocol, Figures 31-34, address selection Tables 9-10), p.32-38 (register descriptions), p.39-42 (register map), p.52 (factory default, power up)
